# `gog classroom submissions list`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-classroom-submissions-list.md

# `gog classroom submissions list`

List student submissions

## Usage

```bash
gog classroom (class) submissions (submission) list (ls) <courseId> <courseworkId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog classroom submissions](gog-classroom-submissions.md)

## Flags

| `--all`<br>`--all-pages`<br>`--allpages` | `bool` |  | Fetch all pages |
| `--fail-empty`<br>`--non-empty`<br>`--require-results` | `bool` |  | Exit with code 3 if no results |
| `--late` | `string` |  | Late filter: late\|not-late |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 100 | Max results |
| `--page`<br>`--cursor` | `string` |  | Page token |
| `--state` | `string` |  | Submission states filter (comma-separated: NEW,CREATED,TURNED_IN,RETURNED,RECLAIMED_BY_STUDENT) |
| `--user` | `string` |  | Filter by user ID or email |

## See Also

- [gog classroom submissions](gog-classroom-submissions.md)

---

# `gog contacts create`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-contacts-create.md

# `gog contacts create`

Create a contact

## Usage

```bash
gog contacts (contact) create (add,new) [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

## Flags

| `--address` | `[]string` |  | Postal address (can be repeated for multiple addresses) |
| `--custom` | `[]string` |  | Custom field as key=value (can be repeated) |
| `--email` | `string` |  | Email address |
| `--family` | `string` |  | Family name |
| `--gender` | `string` |  | Gender value |
| `--given` | `string` |  | Given name (required) |
| `--note` | `string` |  | Note/biography |
| `--org` | `string` |  | Organization/company name |
| `--phone` | `string` |  | Phone number |
| `--relation` | `[]string` |  | Relation as type=person (can be repeated) |
| `--title` | `string` |  | Job title |
| `--url` | `[]string` |  | URL (can be repeated for multiple URLs) |

## See Also

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

---

# `gog contacts dedupe`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-contacts-dedupe.md

# `gog contacts dedupe`

Find likely duplicate contacts and optionally merge them

## Usage

```bash
gog contacts (contact) dedupe [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

## Flags

| `--apply`<br>`--merge` | `bool` |  | Merge duplicate groups and delete redundant contacts (requires confirmation) |
| `--fail-empty`<br>`--non-empty`<br>`--require-results` | `bool` |  | Exit with code 3 if no duplicates |
| `--match` | `string` | email,phone | Match fields: email,phone,name |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 0 | Max contacts to scan (0 = all) |
| `--resource` | `[]string` |  | Limit dedupe to exact contact resource names (people/...); repeatable |

## See Also

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

---

# `gog contacts export`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-contacts-export.md

# `gog contacts export`

Export contacts as vCard (.vcf)

## Usage

```bash
gog contacts (contact) export [<selector>] [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

## Flags

| `--all` | `bool` |  | Export all personal contacts |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 30 | Max results for --query (1-30) |
| `-o`<br>`--out` | `string` | - | Output path (.vcf), or - for stdout |
| `--page` | `string` |  | Start page token for --all |
| `--page-size` | `int64` | 1000 | Page size for --all (1-1000) |
| `--query` | `string` |  | Search query to export (max 30 results) |

## See Also

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

# `gog contacts update`

Update a contact

## Usage

```bash
gog contacts (contact) update (edit,set) <resourceName> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

## Flags

| `--address` | `[]string` |  | Postal address (can be repeated; empty clears all) |
| `--birthday` | `string` |  | Birthday in YYYY-MM-DD (empty clears) |
| `--custom` | `[]string` |  | Custom field as key=value (can be repeated; empty clears all) |
| `--email` | `string` |  | Email address (empty clears) |
| `--family` | `string` |  | Family name |
| `--from-file` | `string` |  | Update from contact JSON file (use - for stdin) |
| `--gender` | `string` |  | Gender value (empty clears) |
| `--given` | `string` |  | Given name |
| `--ignore-etag` | `bool` |  | Allow updating even if the JSON etag is stale (may overwrite concurrent changes) |
| `--note` | `string` |  | Note/biography (empty clears) |
| `--notes` | `string` |  | Notes (stored as People API biography; empty clears) |
| `--org` | `string` |  | Organization/company name (empty clears) |
| `--phone` | `string` |  | Phone number (empty clears) |
| `--relation` | `[]string` |  | Relation as type=person (can be repeated; empty clears all) |
| `--title` | `string` |  | Job title (empty clears) |
| `--url` | `[]string` |  | URL (can be repeated; empty clears all) |

## See Also

- [gog contacts](gog-contacts.md)

# `gog docs cell-style`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-docs-cell-style.md

# `gog docs cell-style`

Apply table cell, border, padding, alignment, and text styling

## Usage

```bash
gog docs (doc) cell-style --row=INT --col=INT <docId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

## Flags

| `--background-color`<br>`--bg-color` | `string` |  | Cell background color as #RRGGBB or #RGB |
| `--batch` | `string` |  | Append requests to a persisted Docs batch instead of submitting |
| `--bold` | `bool` |  | Set cell text bold |
| `--border-all` | `string` |  | All borders as WIDTH[,COLOR[,SOLID\|DOT\|DASH]] (e.g. 1pt,#000,DASH) |
| `--border-bottom` | `string` |  | Bottom border; overrides --border-all |
| `--border-left` | `string` |  | Left border; overrides --border-all |
| `--border-right` | `string` |  | Right border; overrides --border-all |
| `--border-top` | `string` |  | Top border; overrides --border-all |
| `--col` | `int` |  | 1-based column number |
| `--col-span` | `int64` | 1 | Number of columns to style |
| `--content-align` | `string` |  | Vertical content alignment: top, middle, or bottom |
| `--italic` | `bool` |  | Set cell text italic |
| `--padding-all` | `string` |  | All cell padding (points by default; supports pt, in, cm, mm) |
| `--padding-bottom` | `string` |  | Bottom cell padding; overrides --padding-all |
| `--padding-left` | `string` |  | Left cell padding; overrides --padding-all |
| `--padding-right` | `string` |  | Right cell padding; overrides --padding-all |
| `--padding-top` | `string` |  | Top cell padding; overrides --padding-all |
| `--row` | `int` |  | 1-based row number |
| `--row-span` | `int64` | 1 | Number of rows to style |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | Target a specific tab by title or ID (see docs list-tabs) |
| `--table-index` | `int` | 1 | 1-based table index in document order; negative indexes count from the end |
| `--text-color` | `string` |  | Text color as #RRGGBB or #RGB |
| `--underline` | `bool` |  | Set cell text underline |

## See Also

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

---

# `gog docs comments poll`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-docs-comments-poll.md

# `gog docs comments poll`

Poll new and modified comments with persisted state

## Usage

```bash
gog docs (doc) comments poll --state-file=STRING <docId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog docs comments](gog-docs-comments.md)

## Flags

| `--include-resolved`<br>`--resolved` | `bool` |  | Include resolved comments |
| `--interval` | `time.Duration` | 60s | Delay between polls |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 100 | Max comments per API page |
| `--max-iterations` | `int` | 0 | Stop after N polls; 0 runs until interrupted |
| `--on-new` | `string` |  | Trusted local shell command run for each comment; comment event JSON is provided on stdin |
| `--state-file` | `string` |  | JSON file that stores the comment time watermark |

## See Also

- [gog docs comments](gog-docs-comments.md)

# `gog docs delete`

## Usage

## Parent

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

## Flags

| `--end` | `*int64` |  | End index (> start; required unless --at is set) |
| `--match-case` | `bool` |  | Use case-sensitive --at matching |
| `--occurrence` | `*int` |  | Use the Nth --at match (1-based; required when --at is ambiguous) |
| `--segment` | `string` |  | Target an exact header, footer, or footnote segment ID |
| `--start` | `*int64` |  | Start index (>= 1; required unless --at is set) |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | Target a specific tab by title or ID (see docs list-tabs) |

# `gog docs find-replace`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-docs-find-replace.md

# `gog docs find-replace`

Find and replace text. Supports plain text or markdown with images; use --first for a single occurrence.

## Usage

```bash
gog docs (doc) find-replace <docId> <find> [<replace>] [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

## Flags

| `--content-file` | `string` |  | Read replacement from a file instead of the positional argument. |
| `--first` | `bool` |  | Replace only the first occurrence instead of all. |
| `--format` | `string` | plain | Replacement format: plain\|markdown. Markdown converts formatting, tables, and inline images from public HTTPS URLs. |
| `--match-case` | `bool` |  | Case-sensitive matching |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | Target a specific tab by title or ID (see docs list-tabs) |

## See Also

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

---

# `gog docs format`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-docs-format.md

# `gog docs format`

Apply text or paragraph formatting to a Google Doc

## Usage

```bash
gog docs (doc) format <docId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

## Flags

| `--alignment` | `string` |  | Paragraph alignment: left, center, right, justify, start, end, justified |
| `--batch` | `string` |  | Append requests to a persisted Docs batch instead of submitting |
| `--bg-color` | `string` |  | Text background color as #RRGGBB or #RGB |
| `--bold` | `bool` |  | Set bold |
| `--bullet-preset` | `string` |  | Create a list with a Google Docs bullet glyph preset |
| `--bullets` | `bool` |  | Create a bulleted list with the default disc preset |
| `--code` | `bool` |  | Apply code style (Courier New + grey background) |
| `--font-family` | `string` |  | Font family, for example Arial or Georgia |
| `--font-size` | `float64` |  | Font size in points |
| `--heading-level` | `*int` |  | Set paragraph named style to HEADING_1..HEADING_6 (shortcut for --named-style=HEADING_N) |
| `--indent-end` | `*float64` |  | Paragraph end indentation in points |
| `--indent-first-line` | `*float64` |  | Paragraph first-line indentation in points |
| `--indent-start` | `*float64` |  | Paragraph start indentation in points |
| `--italic` | `bool` |  | Set italic |
| `--keep-lines-together` | `*bool` |  | Keep all paragraph lines on one page or column when possible; use --no-keep-lines-together to clear |
| `--keep-with-next` | `*bool` |  | Keep the paragraph with the next paragraph when possible; use --no-keep-with-next to clear |
| `--line-spacing` | `float64` |  | Paragraph line spacing percentage, for example 100 or 150 |
| `--link` | `string` |  | Set hyperlink target (http://, https://, mailto:, #bookmarkId, or #heading-slug) |
| `--match` | `string` |  | Only format the first text match |
| `--match-all` | `bool` |  | Format all matches instead of only the first |
| `--match-case` | `bool` |  | Use case-sensitive matching with --match |
| `--named-style` | `string` |  | Set paragraph named style: NORMAL_TEXT, TITLE, SUBTITLE, HEADING_1..HEADING_6 |
| `--no-bold` | `bool` |  | Clear bold |
| `--no-bullets` | `bool` |  | Remove bullets or numbering |
| `--no-italic` | `bool` |  | Clear italic |
| `--no-link` | `bool` |  | Clear hyperlink |
| `--no-strikethrough`<br>`--no-strike` | `bool` |  | Clear strikethrough |
| `--no-underline` | `bool` |  | Clear underline |
| `--ordered` | `bool` |  | Create a numbered list with the default decimal preset |
| `--segment` | `string` |  | Target an exact header, footer, or footnote segment ID |
| `--space-above` | `*float64` |  | Space above the paragraph in points |
| `--space-below` | `*float64` |  | Space below the paragraph in points |
| `--spacing-mode` | `string` |  | Paragraph spacing mode: NEVER_COLLAPSE or COLLAPSE_LISTS |
| `--strikethrough`<br>`--strike` | `bool` |  | Set strikethrough |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | Target a specific tab by title or ID (see docs list-tabs) |
| `--text-color` | `string` |  | Text color as #RRGGBB or #RGB |
| `--underline` | `bool` |  | Set underline |

## See Also

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

---

```bash
gog docs (doc) insert-image <docId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

## Flags

| `--at` | `*string` |  | Placeholder text to delete and replace, or 'end' to append |

| `--file` | `string` |  | Local PNG, JPEG, or GIF image to upload and insert |
| `--height` | `float64` |  | Image height in points (optional; width-only preserves aspect ratio) |
| `--name` | `string` |  | Override uploaded Drive filename |
| `--on-restricted` | `string` | error | If public sharing is blocked: error\|link |
| `--parent` | `string` |  | Drive folder ID for the uploaded image |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | Target a specific tab by title or ID (see docs list-tabs) |
| `--url` | `string` |  | Public HTTPS image URL to insert directly |
| `--width` | `float64` | 468 | Image width in points; default 468pt |

## Parent

## Flags

| `--at` | `string` |  | Create the range around literal matched text |
| `--end` | `*int64` |  | Range end UTF-16 index (exclusive) |
| `--match-case` | `bool` |  | Use case-sensitive --at matching |
| `--name` | `string` |  | Unique named range name |
| `--occurrence` | `*int` |  | Use the Nth --at match (1-based; required when --at is ambiguous) |
| `--start` | `*int64` |  | Range start UTF-16 index (inclusive) |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | Target a specific tab by title or ID (see docs list-tabs) |

## See Also

- [gog docs named-range](gog-docs-named-range.md)

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-docs-update.md

# `gog docs update`

Insert or replace text at a specific index or range in a Google Doc

## Usage

```bash
gog docs (doc) update <docId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

## Flags

| `--at` | `string` |  | Anchor by literal text and replace that matched range |
| `--batch` | `string` |  | Append requests to a persisted Docs batch instead of submitting |
| `--file` | `string` |  | Text file path ('-' for stdin) |
| `--index` | `int64` |  | Insert index (default: end of document) |
| `--markdown` | `bool` |  | Convert markdown to Google Docs formatting |
| `--match-case` | `bool` |  | Use case-sensitive --at matching |
| `--occurrence` | `*int` |  | Use the Nth --at match (1-based; required when --at is ambiguous) |
| `--pageless` | `bool` |  | Set document to pageless mode |
| `--replace-range` | `string` |  | Replace UTF-16 Docs API range START:END instead of inserting |
| `--segment` | `string` |  | Target an exact header, footer, or footnote segment ID |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | Target a specific tab by title or ID (see docs list-tabs) |
| `--text` | `string` |  | Text to insert |

## See Also

- [gog docs](gog-docs.md)

| `--keep-with-next` | `*bool` |  | Keep the paragraph with the next paragraph when possible; use --no-keep-with-next to clear |
| `--line-spacing` | `float64` |  | Paragraph line spacing percentage, for example 100 or 150 |
| `--margin-bottom` | `string` |  | Set bottom page margin (points by default; supports pt, in, cm, mm) |
| `--margin-left` | `string` |  | Set left page margin (points by default; supports pt, in, cm, mm) |
| `--margin-right` | `string` |  | Set right page margin (points by default; supports pt, in, cm, mm) |
| `--margin-top` | `string` |  | Set top page margin (points by default; supports pt, in, cm, mm) |
| `--markdown` | `bool` |  | Convert markdown to Google Docs formatting (requires --replace or --append) |
| `--named-style` | `string` |  | Set paragraph named style: NORMAL_TEXT, TITLE, SUBTITLE, HEADING_1..HEADING_6 |
| `--no-bold` | `bool` |  | Clear bold |
| `--no-bullets` | `bool` |  | Remove bullets or numbering |
| `--no-italic` | `bool` |  | Clear italic |
| `--no-strikethrough`<br>`--no-strike` | `bool` |  | Clear strikethrough |
| `--no-underline` | `bool` |  | Clear underline |

| `--page-size` | `string` |  | Named page size: A4, A5, Letter, Legal, Tabloid |

# `gog drive changes serve`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-changes-serve.md

# `gog drive changes serve`

Receive Drive change notifications and run a local hook

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) changes serve --state-file=STRING [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive changes](gog-drive-changes.md)

## Flags

| `--auto-renew` | `bool` |  | Create and renew the Drive notification channel |
| `--cert` | `string` |  | TLS certificate path; pair with --key (omit behind an HTTPS reverse proxy) |
| `--channel-token` | `string` |  | Expected X-Goog-Channel-Token value |
| `--channel-token-file` | `string` |  | Read the expected channel token from a file |
| `--channel-ttl` | `time.Duration` | 24h | Requested channel lifetime |
| `--drive`<br>`--drive-id` | `string` |  | Shared drive ID for a shared-drive change log |
| `--filter-file` | `string` |  | Only invoke the hook for changes to this file ID |
| `--include-removed` | `bool` | true | Include removed changes |
| `--key` | `string` |  | TLS private key path; pair with --cert |
| `--listen` | `string` | 127.0.0.1:8443 | Listen address |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 100 | Max changes per API page |
| `--notification-timeout` | `time.Duration` | 5m | Maximum time for one callback, including Drive reads and the hook |
| `--on-change` | `string` |  | Trusted local shell command run for each non-empty change batch; event JSON is provided on stdin |
| `--path` | `string` | /drive-changes | Notification handler path |
| `--renew-before` | `time.Duration` | 10m | Renew this long before channel expiration |
| `--state-file` | `string` |  | JSON file that stores the current Drive page token and channel state |
| `--token` | `string` |  | Initial Drive page token when creating a new state file |
| `--webhook-url` | `string` |  | Public HTTPS callback URL used by --auto-renew |

## See Also

- [gog drive changes](gog-drive-changes.md)

# `gog drive changes`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-changes.md

# `gog drive changes`

Track Drive changes for sync and automation

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) changes <command>
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Subcommands

- [gog drive changes list](gog-drive-changes-list.md) - List Drive changes since a page token
- [gog drive changes poll](gog-drive-changes-poll.md) - Poll Drive changes with a persisted page token
- [gog drive changes serve](gog-drive-changes-serve.md) - Receive Drive change notifications and run a local hook
- [gog drive changes start-token](gog-drive-changes-start-token.md) - Get a Drive changes start page token
- [gog drive changes stop](gog-drive-changes-stop.md) - Stop a Drive changes webhook channel
- [gog drive changes watch](gog-drive-changes-watch.md) - Watch Drive changes with a webhook channel

## Flags

## See Also

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

# `gog drive comments list`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-comments-list.md

# `gog drive comments list`

List comments on a file

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) comments list (ls) <fileId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive comments](gog-drive-comments.md)

## Flags

| `--all`<br>`--all-pages`<br>`--allpages` | `bool` |  | Fetch all pages |
| `--fail-empty`<br>`--non-empty`<br>`--require-results` | `bool` |  | Exit with code 3 if no results |
| `--include-quoted` | `bool` |  | Include the quoted content the comment is anchored to |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 100 | Max results |
| `--page`<br>`--cursor` | `string` |  | Page token |
| `--since` | `string` |  | Only return comments modified at or after this RFC3339 timestamp |

## See Also

- [gog drive comments](gog-drive-comments.md)

# `gog drive download`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-download.md

# `gog drive download`

Download a file (exports Google Docs formats)

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) download <fileId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Flags

| `--format` | `string` |  | Export format for Google Docs files: pdf\|csv\|xlsx\|pptx\|txt\|png\|docx\|md (default: inferred) |
| `--out`<br>`--output` | `string` |  | Output file path (default: gogcli config dir) |
| `--overwrite` | `bool` |  | Overwrite an existing output file |
| `--tab` | `string` |  | (experimental) Export a specific tab by title or ID (Google Docs only; see 'gog docs list-tabs') |

## See Also

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

# `gog drive du`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-du.md

# `gog drive du`

Summarize Drive folder sizes

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) du [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Flags

| `--all-drives` | `bool` | true | Include shared drives (default: true; use --no-all-drives for My Drive only) |
| `--depth` | `int` | 1 | Depth for folder totals |
| `--max` | `int` | 50 | Max folders to return (0 = unlimited) |
| `--order` | `string` | desc | Sort order |
| `--parent` | `string` |  | Folder ID to start from (default: root) |
| `--sort` | `string` | size | Sort by size\|path\|files |

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

# `gog drive labels file apply`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-labels-file-apply.md

# `gog drive labels file apply`

Apply or update a label on a Drive file

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) labels (label) file apply <fileId> <labelId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive labels file](gog-drive-labels-file.md)

## Flags

| `--date` | `[]string` |  | Set date field as field=YYYY-MM-DD[,YYYY-MM-DD] (repeatable) |
| `--fields-json` | `string` |  | Simple JSON object of fieldId to string/number/bool/string-array values (strings become text fields) |
| `--integer` | `[]string` |  | Set integer field as field=123[,456] (repeatable) |
| `--selection` | `[]string` |  | Set selection field as field=choiceId[,choiceId] (repeatable) |
| `--text` | `[]string` |  | Set text field as field=value (repeatable) |
| `--unset` | `[]string` |  | Unset field ID (repeatable) |
| `--user` | `[]string` |  | Set user field as field=email[,email] (repeatable) |

## See Also

- [gog drive labels file](gog-drive-labels-file.md)

# `gog drive labels list`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-labels-list.md

# `gog drive labels list`

List Drive label schemas

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) labels (label) list (ls) [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive labels](gog-drive-labels.md)

## Flags

| `--admin-access` | `bool` |  | Use admin access for Workspace admin accounts |
| `--customer` | `string` |  | Customer resource (for example customers/123abc789); Google Workspace customer required |
| `--fields` | `string` |  | Drive Labels API field mask override |
| `--language` | `string` |  | BCP-47 language code |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 50 | Max results |
| `--minimum-role` | `string` |  | Minimum role filter (for example READER, APPLIER, ORGANIZER) |
| `--page`<br>`--cursor` | `string` |  | Page token |
| `--published-only` | `bool` | true | Only list published labels |
| `--view` | `string` | LABEL_VIEW_BASIC | Label view: LABEL_VIEW_BASIC\|LABEL_VIEW_FULL |

## See Also

- [gog drive labels](gog-drive-labels.md)

# `gog drive ls`

List files in a folder (default: root)

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) ls [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Flags

| `--all`<br>`--global` | `bool` |  | List all accessible files (mutually exclusive with --parent) |
| `--all-drives` | `bool` | true | Include shared drives (default: true; use --no-all-drives for My Drive only) |
| `--fields` | `string` |  | Drive API field mask (overrides the default set; e.g. 'files(id,name,thumbnailLink),nextPageToken') |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 20 | Max results |
| `--page`<br>`--cursor` | `string` |  | Page token |
| `--parent` | `string` |  | Folder ID to list (default: root) |
| `--query` | `string` |  | Drive query filter |

## See Also

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

# `gog drive search`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-search.md

# `gog drive search`

Full-text search across Drive

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) search <query> ... [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Flags

| `--all-drives` | `bool` | true | Include shared drives (default: true; use --no-all-drives for My Drive only) |
| `--drive`<br>`--drive-id` | `string` |  | Scope search to a specific shared drive (uses corpora=drive with driveId). Mutually exclusive with --no-all-drives. Pass the driveId from 'gog drive drives'. |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 20 | Max results |
| `--page`<br>`--cursor` | `string` |  | Page token |
| `--parent` | `string` |  | Scope search to direct children of a specific folder or shared drive. Wraps the query with "'<parentId>' in parents". |
| `--raw-query`<br>`--raw` | `bool` |  | Treat query as Drive query language (pass through; may error if invalid) |

## See Also

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

---

# `gog drive share`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-share.md

# `gog drive share`

Share a file or folder

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) share <fileId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Flags

| `--discoverable` | `bool` |  | Allow file discovery in search (anyone/domain only) |
| `--domain` | `string` |  | Domain (for --to=domain; e.g. example.com) |
| `--email` | `string` |  | User email (for --to=user) |
| `--notify` | `bool` |  | Send Drive invitation email for user/domain shares |
| `--role` | `string` | reader | Permission: reader\|writer\|commenter |
| `--to` | `string` |  | Share target: anyone\|user\|domain |

## See Also

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

# `gog drive shortcut create`

# `gog drive tree`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-tree.md

# `gog drive tree`

Print a read-only folder tree

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) tree [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Flags

| `--all-drives` | `bool` | true | Include shared drives (default: true; use --no-all-drives for My Drive only) |
| `--depth` | `int` | 2 | Max depth (0 = unlimited) |
| `--max` | `int` | 0 | Max items to return (0 = unlimited) |
| `--parent` | `string` |  | Folder ID to start from (default: root) |

## See Also

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

# `gog drive upload`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive-upload.md

# `gog drive upload`

Upload a file

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) upload <localPath> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

## Flags

| `--convert` | `bool` |  | Auto-convert to native Google format based on file extension (create only) |
| `--convert-to` | `string` |  | Convert to a specific Google format: doc\|sheet\|slides (create only) |
| `--keep-frontmatter` | `bool` |  | Keep YAML frontmatter (---) in Markdown when converting to a Google Doc (--convert or --convert-to doc; default: strip) |
| `--keep-revision-forever` | `bool` |  | Keep the new head revision forever (binary files only) |
| `--mime-type` | `string` |  | Override MIME type inference |
| `--name` | `string` |  | Override filename (create) or rename target (replace) |
| `--parent` | `string` |  | Destination folder ID (create only) |
| `--replace` | `string` |  | Replace the content of an existing Drive file ID (preserves shared link/permissions) |

## See Also

- [gog drive](gog-drive.md)

---

# `gog drive`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-drive.md

# `gog drive`

Google Drive

## Usage

```bash
gog drive (drv) <command> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog](gog.md)

## Subcommands

- [gog drive activity](gog-drive-activity.md) - Query Drive Activity audit events
- [gog drive audit](gog-drive-audit.md) - Audit Drive sharing without mutation
- [gog drive bulk](gog-drive-bulk.md) - Bulk Drive permission operations
- [gog drive changes](gog-drive-changes.md) - Track Drive changes for sync and automation
- [gog drive comments](gog-drive-comments.md) - Manage comments on files
- [gog drive copy](gog-drive-copy.md) - Copy a file
- [gog drive delete](gog-drive-delete.md) - Move a file to trash (use --permanent to delete forever)
- [gog drive download](gog-drive-download.md) - Download a file (exports Google Docs formats)
- [gog drive drives](gog-drive-drives.md) - List shared drives (Team Drives)
- [gog drive du](gog-drive-du.md) - Summarize Drive folder sizes
- [gog drive get](gog-drive-get.md) - Get file metadata
- [gog drive inventory](gog-drive-inventory.md) - Export a read-only Drive inventory
- [gog drive labels](gog-drive-labels.md) - Read and modify Drive labels
- [gog drive ls](gog-drive-ls.md) - List files in a folder (default: root)
- [gog drive mkdir](gog-drive-mkdir.md) - Create a folder
- [gog drive move](gog-drive-move.md) - Move a file to a different folder
- [gog drive permissions](gog-drive-permissions.md) - List permissions on a file
- [gog drive raw](gog-drive-raw.md) - Dump raw Google Drive API response as JSON (Files.Get; lossless; for scripting and LLM consumption)
- [gog drive rename](gog-drive-rename.md) - Rename a file or folder
- [gog drive revisions](gog-drive-revisions.md) - List and inspect file revisions
- [gog drive search](gog-drive-search.md) - Full-text search across Drive
- [gog drive share](gog-drive-share.md) - Share a file or folder
- [gog drive shortcut](gog-drive-shortcut.md) - Manage shortcuts to Drive files and folders
- [gog drive tree](gog-drive-tree.md) - Print a read-only folder tree
- [gog drive unshare](gog-drive-unshare.md) - Remove a permission from a file
- [gog drive upload](gog-drive-upload.md) - Upload a file
- [gog drive url](gog-drive-url.md) - Print web URLs for files

## Flags

## See Also

- [gog](gog.md)

# `gog forms add-question`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-forms-add-question.md

# `gog forms add-question`

Add a question to a form

## Usage

```bash
gog forms (form) add-question (add-q,aq) --title=STRING <formId> [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog forms](gog-forms.md)

## Flags

| `--correct` | `[]string` |  | Correct answer value for quiz grading (repeat for multiple accepted/checkbox answers) |
| `--description` | `string` |  | Question description/help text |
| `--duration` | `bool` |  | Ask for duration instead of time (for time type) |
| `--include-time` | `bool` |  | Include time picker (for date type) |
| `--include-year` | `bool` |  | Include year field (for date type) |
| `--index` | `int` | -1 | Position to insert (0-based, default append) |
| `-o`<br>`--option` | `[]string` |  | Choice options (for radio/checkbox/dropdown, repeat for each) |
| `--points` | `int` |  | Positive quiz points for the question when --correct is set |
| `--required` | `bool` |  | Whether an answer is required |
| `--scale-high` | `int` | 5 | Scale maximum value: 2 through 10 |
| `--scale-high-label` | `string` |  | Label for high end of scale |
| `--scale-low` | `int` | 1 | Scale minimum value: 0 or 1 |
| `--scale-low-label` | `string` |  | Label for low end of scale |
| `--title` | `string` |  | Question title/text |
| `--type` | `string` | text | Question type: text\|paragraph\|radio\|checkbox\|dropdown\|scale\|date\|time |

## See Also

- [gog forms](gog-forms.md)

---

# `gog gmail archive`

Archive messages or explicit threads (remove from inbox)

## Usage

```bash
gog gmail (mail,email) archive [<messageId> ...] [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog gmail](gog-gmail.md)

## Flags

| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 100 | Max messages to archive (with --query) |
| `-q`<br>`--query` | `string` |  | Archive all messages matching this Gmail search query |
| `--thread` | `bool` |  | Treat positional IDs as thread IDs and archive every message in each thread |

## See Also

- [gog gmail](gog-gmail.md)

# `gog gmail autoreply`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-gmail-autoreply.md

# `gog gmail autoreply`

Reply once to matching messages

## Usage

```bash
gog gmail (mail,email) autoreply <query> ... [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog gmail](gog-gmail.md)

## Flags

| `--allow-self` | `bool` |  | Allow replying to messages sent by your own account/alias |
| `--archive` | `bool` |  | Archive threads after auto-replying |
| `--body` | `string` |  | Reply body (plain text; required unless --body-html is set) |
| `--body-file` | `string` |  | Reply body file path (plain text; '-' for stdin) |
| `--body-html` | `string` |  | Reply body HTML |
| `--from` | `string` |  | Send from this email address (must be a verified send-as alias) |
| `--label` | `string` | AutoReplied | Label to add after replying (used for dedupe) |
| `--mark-read` | `bool` |  | Mark threads as read after auto-replying |
| `--max`<br>`--limit` | `int64` | 20 | Max matching messages to inspect |
| `--reply-to` | `string` |  | Reply-To header address |
| `--skip-bulk` | `bool` | true | Skip auto-generated/list mail |
| `--subject` | `string` |  | Override reply subject (default: reply to original subject) |

## See Also

- [gog gmail](gog-gmail.md)

---

# `gog gmail batch`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-gmail-batch.md

# `gog gmail batch`

Batch operations (permanent delete requires broader Gmail scope; use gmail trash for normal trashing)

## Usage

```bash
gog gmail (mail,email) batch <command>
```

## Parent

- [gog gmail](gog-gmail.md)

## Subcommands

- [gog gmail batch delete](gog-gmail-batch-delete.md) - Permanently delete messages; requires https://mail.google.com/ OAuth scope (use 'gmail trash' with the default scope)
- [gog gmail batch modify](gog-gmail-batch-modify.md) - Modify labels on multiple messages

# `gog gmail drafts create`

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/blob/main/docs/commands/gog-gmail-drafts-create.md

# `gog gmail drafts create`

Create a draft

## Usage

```bash
gog gmail (mail,email) drafts (draft) create (add,new) [flags]
```

## Parent

- [gog gmail drafts](gog-gmail-drafts.md)

## Flags

| `--attach` | `[]string` |  | Attachment file path (repeatable) |
| `--bcc` | `string` |  | BCC recipients (comma-separated) |
| `--body` | `string` |  | Body (plain text; required unless --body-html is set) |
| `--body-file` | `string` |  | Body file path (plain text; '-' for stdin) |
| `--body-html` | `string` |  | Body (HTML; optional) |
| `--body-html-file` | `string` |  | HTML body file path ('-' for stdin) |
| `--cc` | `string` |  | CC recipients (comma-separated) |
| `--from` | `string` |  | Send from this email address (must be a verified send-as alias) |
| `--quote` | `bool` |  | Include quoted original message in reply (requires --reply-to-message-id or --thread-id) |
| `--reply-all` | `bool` |  | Auto-populate recipients from original message (requires --reply-to-message-id or --thread-id) |
| `--reply-to` | `string` |  | Reply-To header address |
| `--reply-to-message-id` | `string` |  | Reply to Gmail message ID (sets In-Reply-To/References and thread) |
| `--subject` | `string` |  | Subject (required) |
| `--thread-id` | `string` |  | Reply within a Gmail thread (uses latest message for headers) |
| `--to` | `string` |  | Recipients (comma-separated) |

## See Also

- [gog gmail drafts](gog-gmail-drafts.md)
